g.text: CHAPTER III • ROYAL CONFECTIONS
Folio 05
MENUQR ROYAL ARCHIVES • ESTD 1924
IMPERIAL CONFECTIONS
SHAHI DESSERTS & EDIBLE GOLD
Shahi Tukda Royale
Ghee-crisped milk brioche steeped in wild cardamom syrup, crowned with 4-hour reduced laccha rabri,
roasted Afghan pistachios, and certified 99.9% pure 24K edible gold and silver vark.
Zaffrani Kesar Phirni
Stone-ground aged Basmati pudding steeped in pure Pampore saffron, served chilled in earthen kulhads
with green cardamom dust and handpicked Damask rose petal confetti.
Gulab Ki Kheer
Rich buffalo milk reduced slowly over embers, infused with fresh Damask rose water,
blanched almonds, chironji nuts, and dried rose petals from Kannauj distilleries.
PHILOSOPHY OF ROYAL CONFECTIONS
THE ARTISANAL SWEETS COVENANT • 1924
"True sweetness dissolves all distance between human hearts;"
"And pure saffron breathes renewed nobility into the tired soul."
"We use only laboratory-certified 99.9% pure silver and 24K gold foil,
hand-beaten through 12,000 strikes inside parchment pouches
by master Vark artisan guilds of Chowk, Old Lucknow.
Zero chemical adulteration • 100% pure vegetarian craftsmanship."
— Hakim-e-Shahi • Chief Imperial Confectioner & Physician (1924)
LUCKNOW GOLD VARK GUILD • LAB CERTIFIED 99.9% PURE
CHAPTER III • ROYAL CONFECTIONS
Folio 06
MENUQR ROYAL ARCHIVES • ESTD 1924
THE CLOSING CEREMONY
KASHMIRI KAHWA & HOSPITALITY
Kashmiri Saffron Kahwa
Handpicked green tea leaves brewed in a brass samovar with cinnamon quills, green cardamom,
crimson saffron strands, and finely sliced toasted almonds. Served piping hot.
Imperial Kadak Masala Chai
Single-estate Assam second-flush orthodox tea leaves slow-simmered with crushed ginger,
cloves, black pepper, and whole milk, aerated high into clay kulhads.
ATITHI DEVO BHAVA • THE SACRED CODE
THE ROYAL INDIAN HOSPITALITY COVENANT
"The guest is divine grace personified upon this earth;"
"Whose gracious comfort is our highest honor and devotion."
"In the royal heritage of India, no banquet concludes
with the simple settling of an account.
Every esteemed guest is presented with warm rosewater towels,
sweet silver-leaf betel paan, and fragrant botanical mukhwas,
carrying the blessed perfume of our dastarkhwan into the night."
— Imperial Court Hospitality Protocol • Established 1924
ATITHI SEVA
MQR
ROSEWATER MUKHWAS
